label: two charges at Claywater
intent: hook (dry season only: seasonIs dry; her greeting links the topic, as do the keepers', from the settlement's talk of the cracked well, culture.settlement.claywater-station rumour 0): both banks charge more this season for one stop; the landing's clay cut below the ford has a crocodile in it and the rains are close; sends the player to Livia Varinius at the well and Signs-For-The-Cargo at the raft

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the station's side: 2 drakes a traveller this season for the stop and its water, to pay a mason to re-line the cracked well in stone, since the landing would not haul stone; she names the price and the player chooses to pay (a choice line: takeGold 2, then giveItem item.lf83.well-water, her dipper) or not; the landing's new charge is on walkers who wade a ford anyone can wade, and she has never charged the landing for water

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the landing's side: 1 drake a head now to wade, more by the wheel for a cart on the raft; he names it and the player chooses to pay (takeGold 1) or not; the ford was worked before the well was dug; the landing does not drink the well's water or haul stone for it; there is a price for walkers to go free (the line grants topic.lf83-ford-charge); the landing's clay cut has a crocodile in it (the line grants topic.lf83-clay-bend)

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the station's doubter as Gaius Vibius speaks (written for the packet that places him, not Part 1): the station keeps its own pot, but he expects nothing from an Empire that left the well to crack, and would rather see the landing's clay in it than wait for a mason

label: the landing's terms
intent: what the landing would give: no stone ever, but the landing's way with any wall on this bank, clay rammed in behind it, which bends with the bank and keeps the ford out, renewed each dry season with the landing's walls; the landing's drake of one charge, 1 to each bank of 2, would pay for it; there is no clay, because the crocodile has the cut, and the rains are close. Pressed at disposition 30 or more, he admits he set the walkers' charge when the station raised its own (k11), and says Takes-The-Short-Weight told him it was wrong (k13)

label: the landing's terms
intent: her objection: a mason's stone will mend the well; the landing would take half a charge for water it never draws, since its people draw only to wash and she charges them nothing

label: the failing well
intent: at disposition 30 or more: she will tell what is wrong with the station's water if the player brings her a dipper of it (sets flag.lf83.taste-asked); with item.lf83.well-water she tastes it against the ford water by her door and says it is the ford seeping in (takes item.lf83.well-water, sets flag.lf83.ford-tasted); clay holds where mortar cracks; the walkers' charge answered the station's rise and sends travellers to the crocodile, and she told the poler so; the poler's wife has watched Livia mend the well with a trowel every dry season and saw her put silt in a jar under the windlass cover (sets flag.lf83.mending-heard); Livia writes everything in her book. Below 30: she will not talk against her own bank to a stranger, and says so

label: the failing well
intent: until the player has found the yearly mending (no objectiveComplete old-mending): the crack lets the ford in and a mason's proper lining will mend it; she argues for the mason. Once the player has found it and says so: she admits the lining has cracked every year and she has mended it herself each dry season, and still argues that a mason's lining would hold; the line grants topic.lf83-stop-charge

label: the clay bend
intent: the landing digs its plaster clay at the cut below the ford, on the station bank, as it did before the well; a crocodile has the deep pool under it and comes up at anyone on the cut; nobody has dug for ten days and the basket lies at the cut; the landing will hear terms from whoever gives it back its cut before the rains; ask Takes-The-Short-Weight, who tastes everything, what ails the station's water (k13)

label: the clay bend
intent: once the crocodile is dead (not npcAlive the crocodile), he admits he dropped the basket at the cut and ran

label: the clay bend
intent: at disposition 30 or more: travellers slip along the station bank at night past the cut and wade the shallow tail below the pool, where the crocodile lies; their prints are in the clay at dawn; the landing has dug its clay there since before the well

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement: one charge of 2 drakes a stop, 1 to each bank, the landing's clay rammed in behind the lining. She agrees (the line sets flag.lf83.one-charge-station) when both her objections are answered (shapeData.objections); otherwise she gives the open objection and the line grants topic.lf83-stop-charge

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement as the landing hears it. He agrees when both his objections are answered (shapeData.objections): the line takes item.lf83.clay-basket and sets flag.lf83.one-charge-landing, the landing's promise of clay and hands; otherwise he gives the open objection

label: the ford charge
intent: the obvious option: for 100 drakes he takes no charge from walkers this season; with goldAtLeast 100 the agreeing line takes the gold (takeGold 100) and sets flag.lf83.ford-charge-bought; without it he names the price

label: the station's charge
intent: back the landing: once the player has found the yearly mending (objectiveComplete old-mending) and her disposition is 70 or more after intimidation, she drops her rise back to the old drake rather than have it known (sets flag.lf83.stop-charge-dropped); before then she defends the charge

label: latest rumours
intent: hook: guests are falling sick and people blame his food; below 40 he keeps his thoughts from strangers and says so

label: sickness at the spring
intent: he thinks something is in the spring, not his pot; only Im-Moro may go into the pool; ask her, or test the water

label: sickness at the spring
intent: it is the travellers' food; shown the test or the sick guests she grants the player leave to go in, once

label: the body in the spring
intent: she has seen it now; she will have it raised once the killer is named

label: the body in the spring
intent: at first the courier left without paying; shown the rope or the body he admits the pack is in his store

label: the body in the spring
intent: a stake carries the dead person's story; a blank one means the killer knew the custom and chose not to honour the dead

label: the body in the spring
intent: friendly and helpful; blames the fire stand's food and points at Tsono-Ra

intent: he knows his knot; at first evasive; at disposition 40 or shown the rope he admits selling it late to Reeh-Shaal

label: accuse

label: accuse
intent: the wrong accusation: he is shamed and says nothing more

label: the sick root
intent: the Conclave's commission: the Hist is sickening, the village blames the salt works; he stopped buying their salt a year ago

label: the sick root
intent: the salt works foul her spring; nothing of Greenspring's does

label: the sick root
intent: the leaves and the sap; he will not guess the cause
